# Pull Request Guidelines

## Branch Policy & Code Review Rules
- Direct pushes to `main` branch are strictly prohibited.
- All code changes, UI enhancements, and feature additions must be submitted via Pull Requests (PR).
- PRs must pass `yarn build` with 0 errors before merging.

---

### PR Checklist
- [ ] Code follows existing project architecture and Vue 3 / Tailwind design system.
- [ ] Builds cleanly with `yarn build` without errors.
- [ ] Tested responsiveness across desktop, mobile, and LINE LIFF in-app browsers.
- [ ] Verified UI aesthetics and micro-interactions.
